column1: # Each NPC's Delirium settings (delirium_bridge::profile; docs/GUNPLAY.md has this table explained).
# A row applies to an actor its match fits; the rows apply in order, each one's set columns over
# the earlier ones' ("-": left as it is). Every value here is neutral until Patrick sets them:
# Delirium's own body and tuning (GTA IV's man, fitted to the actor's own skeleton) for everyone.
# match           kg  scale strength stiffness reactions near_miss avoid  note
default           -   1     1        1         default   on        on     Everyone: Delirium's own body (its weight), at the actor's own size, its own strength, stiffness and reactions.
race:human        -   -     -        -         -         -         -      Humans (FNV's human races and their skeleton): the only ones Delirium has for now.
actor:creature    -   -     -        -         -         -         -      Creatures: not given to Delirium yet (their skeletons are later).
weight:thin       -   -     -        -         -         -         -      The NPC's weight slider under 33 (FNV's 0 to 100).
